🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, or Internal Rotation; sector returns are mixed, with Communication and Healthcare positive but Technology and Financials negative. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirmation is mixed, with no clear style leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads on the week, with CHTR (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +40.35%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare follows, with AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples is also positive; WMT (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +10.58%) is ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest by sector return: AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) and ORCL (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%) are BELOW TREND. Energy and Financials are also negative; XOM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -11.58%) and GS (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.15%) are BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: F (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%), HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%), IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%), AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%), CHTR (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +40.35%). F, HD, AMGN and CHTR are ABOVE TREND; IBM is in RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5 by weekly performance: AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%), AVGO (1W: -15.02% | 1M: -12.11%), INTU (1W: -13.26% | 1M: -17.27%), LRCX (1W: -12.60% | 1M: -23.18%), AMAT (1W: -11.54% | 1M: -21.29%). All are BELOW TREND; weakness is concentrated in Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves include F (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%), HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) and AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%), all ABOVE TREND. IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) and QCOM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -8.42%) are in RECOVERY; monitor for follow-through.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak overall: sector returns are -3.31% for 1W and -16.09% for 1M; constituent positive-stock breadth is not provided for the 24-stock sector. ACN (1W: +5.71% | 1M: +2.27%) is ABOVE TREND, while IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) and QCOM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -8.42%) are in RECOVERY; AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) is BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft at the sector level, with returns of -0.90% for 1W and -1.17% for 1M; constituent positive-stock breadth is not provided for the 20-stock sector. V (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +5.80%) and MA (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +8.22%) are ABOVE TREND, contrasting with JPM (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.67%) and GS (1W: -8.26% | 1M: -12.15%), both BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare leads among larger defensive sectors, up 1.41% for 1W and 0.52% for 1M; constituent positive-stock breadth is not provided for the 17-stock sector. AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) and LLY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +8.74%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -15.64%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Style mixed / no clear leadership: broad top performers coexist with pronounced Technology and Financials weakness, while overall breadth is 5/11. Monitor strength in HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) and MA (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +8.22%); reduce exposure to persistent Technology laggards such as AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%), ABOVE TREND; monitor for continued strength, and watch IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%), in RECOVERY, for confirmation. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) and AVGO (1W: -15.02% | 1M: -12.11%), both BELOW TREND; further weakness would reinforce the downtrend.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+2.39% 1W) and Healthcare (+1.41% 1W), both positive on the week; sector-level breadth is 5/11 overall. BEARISH: Technology (-3.31% 1W, -16.09% 1M) and Energy (-1.68% 1W, -11.74% 1M); watch for stabilization before treating the declines as exhausted.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Specific price levels are not included in the supplied data. Track whether AMD (1W: -23.41% | 1M: -27.53%) and AVGO (1W: -15.02% | 1M: -12.11%) extend their BELOW TREND declines, and whether IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) sustains its RECOVERY.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (+45): analyst raised the target; price action confirms the positive tone, with MA (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND. CEG (+40): earnings-estimate upgrades; price diverges from the favorable news, with CEG (1W: -10.45% | 1M: -9.01%) BELOW TREND.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AVGO (-55): reported customer order cuts; selling confirms the negative tone, with AVGO (1W: -15.02% | 1M: -12.11%) BELOW TREND. INTU (-45) and ORCL (-30): target reductions and AI-related concerns align with weakness; INTU (1W: -13.26% | 1M: -17.27%) and ORCL (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -20.42%) are both BELOW TREND. F (-45): analyst concerns diverge from price action; F (1W: +7.89% | 1M: +5.19%) is ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with breadth at 5/11 sectors positive, broad leadership across four sectors in the Top 5, and style mixed / no clear leadership. HD (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +13.43%) and AMGN (1W: +6.32% | 1M: +5.36%) are ABOVE TREND, while IBM (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -2.04%) is in RECOVERY. Monitor Technology weakness and the negative sentiment confirmation in AVGO (1W: -15.02% | 1M: -12.11%), which remains BELOW TREND.
